name: e-paperBoard
lede: Firmware for a battery-powered 7.5-inch e-paper wall display.
summary: Firmware for a battery-powered 7.5-inch e-paper wall display: weather, a to-do list, a family calendar. The board wakes, downloads one image, draws it and goes back to sleep.
description: e-paperBoard is firmware for a battery-powered 7.5-inch e-paper wall display: weather, a to-do list, a family calendar. The board wakes, downloads one image, draws it and goes back to sleep.

card.question: How little can a board do?

items.title: Wake
items.text: The board is asleep almost all the time. A timer or one of its three keys wakes it.

items.title: Download one image
items.text: It joins Wi-Fi and asks the server for the current screen. If the image has not changed, nothing is downloaded.

items.title: Draw and sleep
items.text: It draws the 800 × 480 image and goes back to sleep. The panel keeps the image without power.

aside: An educational project: every pattern and algorithm is named and explained where it is used. The source is meant to be read.
